segments.summary: Reviewed all widget remove/reset/resize, Plan Compile open-build, Planning Wizard Approve And Build, and testing capability-policy wiring lines. Exact contracts strongly bound dispatch, projected availability, accessibility, receipts/events, idempotency, and pre-enable authority; adversarial review found missing destructive recovery, build-identity eligibility, multi-event atomicity, and policy precedence/authority semantics.

Reviewed all visibility-policy, testing-session background/open/redaction-inspect/watch, event-test, accessibility, and JSON-suffix lines. Exact contracts preserve blocker truth, forbid fixture-to-live fabrication, and bound redaction disclosure; adversarial review found unresolved policy precedence, stream handoff and subscription recovery, active-session races, and redaction inspection lifecycle/audit semantics.
